**Ignore `ENOENT` for entries discovered during traversal.**

`entry-kind` and `collect-below` reject the entire load when a discovered entry disappears during `lstat` or `readdir`. `with-reservation!` creates and removes `.rheos-writer-reservation` below `tasks-dir`, so a concurrent load can hit this race when the projection scans the task root.

Handle `ENOENT` only for discovered entries. Keep refusal errors for configured projection roots and other error codes. Explicit subdirectory projections do not necessarily traverse the reservation directory.
